annotation.title_clean: PL n.897/2024 - Dispõe sobre a Autenticação de Mídia Digital criada ou modificada por Inteligência Artificial (IA) e dá outras providências
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 897/2024 - On the Authentication of Digital Media Created or Modified by Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dep. Saullo Vianna, Câmara dos Deputados (Brazil)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian bill presented in the Chamber of Deputies in March 2024 requiring clear, visible, automated marking and authentication of all digital media generated or modified by AI, with platforms responsible for ensuring authenticity and unspecified competent bodies enforcing compliance. No embodied AI content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory authentication of all AI-generated or modified digital media
Clear, visible marking indicating origin and authenticity
Marking and verification done automatically via authenticity-recognition algorithms
Platforms must implement mechanisms ensuring authenticity of AI media
Unspecified competent bodies may inspect and apply sanctions
